+"""Bounded REST polling fallback for the shared market-data service."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import email.utils
+import time
+from collections.abc import Mapping, Sequence
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
+from decimal import Decimal
+from types import MappingProxyType
+from typing import Any, Callable
+
+from mike_trade.market_data.alpaca_history import AlpacaHistoricalBars, HistoricalBar
+
+__all__ = ["PollKind", "PollSnapshot", "TokenBucket", "PollingError", "RestMarketDataPoller"]
+
+
+class PollKind:
+    TRADE = "trade"
+    QUOTE = "quote"
+    BAR = "bar"
+
+
+def _utc(value: datetime, name: str) -> datetime:
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a timezone-aware datetime")
+    return value.astimezone(UTC)
+
+
+def _parse_ts(value: Any) -> datetime:
+    if isinstance(value, datetime):
+        return _utc(value, "provider timestamp")
+    if not isinstance(value, str):
+        raise ValueError("provider timestamp must be ISO formatted")
+    text = value[:-1] + "+00:00" if value.endswith("Z") else value
+    return _utc(datetime.fromisoformat(text), "provider timestamp")
+
+
+def _dec(value: Any) -> Decimal | int | None:
+    if value is None:
+        return None
+    if isinstance(value, (int, Decimal)) and not isinstance(value, bool):
+        return value
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        return Decimal(value)
+    raise ValueError("snapshot numeric values must be int, Decimal, or string")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class PollSnapshot:
+    symbol: str
+    kind: str
+    provider_source_ts: datetime
+    receive_ts: datetime
+    feed_id: str
+    source: str
+    stale: bool
+    values: Mapping[str, Any]
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol", self.symbol.strip().upper())
+        object.__setattr__(self, "provider_source_ts", _utc(self.provider_source_ts, "provider_source_ts"))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "receive_ts", _utc(self.receive_ts, "receive_ts"))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "values", MappingProxyType(dict(self.values)))
+
+
+class PollingError(RuntimeError):
+    pass
+
+
+class TokenBucket:
+    """Synchronous token bucket driven by an injected datetime clock and sleeper."""
+
+    def __init__(self, *, capacity: float, refill_per_second: float,
+                 clock: Callable[[], datetime], sleep: Callable[[float], None] = time.sleep) -> None:
+        if capacity < 1 or refill_per_second <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("capacity and refill_per_second must be positive")
+        self.capacity = float(capacity)
+        self.refill_per_second = float(refill_per_second)
+        self._clock = clock
+        self._sleep = sleep
+        self._tokens = float(capacity)
+        self._updated = _utc(clock(), "clock")
+        self._blocked_until = self._updated
+
+    def defer(self, seconds: float) -> None:
+        if seconds > 0:
+            self._blocked_until = max(self._blocked_until, _utc(self._clock(), "clock") + timedelta(seconds=seconds))
+
+    def acquire(self) -> None:
+        while True:
+            now = _utc(self._clock(), "clock")
+            if now < self._blocked_until:
+                self._sleep((self._blocked_until - now).total_seconds())
+                continue
+            elapsed = max(0.0, (now - self._updated).total_seconds())
+            self._tokens = min(self.capacity, self._tokens + elapsed * self.refill_per_second)
+            self._updated = now
+            if self._tokens >= 1:
+                self._tokens -= 1
+                return
+            self._sleep((1 - self._tokens) / self.refill_per_second)
+
+
+class _LimitedClient:
+    def __init__(self, poller: "RestMarketDataPoller") -> None:
+        self._poller = poller
+
+    def get(self, path: str, params: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None) -> Any:
+        return self._poller._get(path, params)
+
+
+class RestMarketDataPoller:
+    """Fetch each watched symbol once per market-data kind in one batched call."""
+
+    _ENDPOINTS = {
+        PollKind.TRADE: "/v2/stocks/trades/latest",
+        PollKind.QUOTE: "/v2/stocks/quotes/latest",
+        PollKind.BAR: "/v2/stocks/bars/latest",
+    }
+
+    def __init__(self, client: Any, *, clock: Any, feed: str = "iex",
+                 requests_per_second: float = 5.0, burst: int = 5,
+                 poll_interval_seconds: float = 1.0, max_poll_interval_seconds: float = 60.0,
+                 max_symbols_per_cycle: int = 100, stale_after_seconds: float = 30.0,
+                 max_gap: timedelta = timedelta(hours=1), sleep: Callable[[float], None] = time.sleep,
+                 kinds: Sequence[str] = (PollKind.TRADE, PollKind.QUOTE, PollKind.BAR)) -> None:
+        if not callable(getattr(client, "get", None)):
+            raise TypeError("client must expose get(path, params)")
+        if not callable(getattr(clock, "now", None)):
+            raise TypeError("clock must expose now()")
+        if poll_interval_seconds <= 0 or max_poll_interval_seconds <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("poll intervals must be positive")
+        if max_symbols_per_cycle < 1 or stale_after_seconds < 0 or max_gap <= timedelta(0):
+            raise ValueError("poll bounds must be positive")
+        if any(kind not in self._ENDPOINTS for kind in kinds) or not kinds:
+            raise ValueError("kinds must contain trade, quote, and/or bar")
+        self._client, self._clock, self.feed = client, clock, feed.strip().lower()
+        self.poll_interval_seconds = min(poll_interval_seconds, max_poll_interval_seconds)
+        self.max_poll_interval_seconds = max_poll_interval_seconds
+        self.max_symbols_per_cycle = max_symbols_per_cycle
+        self.stale_after_seconds = stale_after_seconds
+        self.max_gap = max_gap
+        self.kinds = tuple(dict.fromkeys(kinds))
+        self._bucket = TokenBucket(capacity=burst, refill_per_second=requests_per_second,
+                                   clock=clock.now, sleep=sleep)
+        self._last_ts: dict[tuple[str, str], datetime] = {}
+        self._retry_until: datetime | None = None
+        self._sleep = sleep
+
+    def _get(self, path: str, params: Mapping[str, Any] | None) -> Any:
+        retries = 0
+        while True:
+            self._bucket.acquire()
+            try:
+                response = self._client.get(path, params=dict(params) if params else None)
+            except Exception as exc:
+                status = getattr(exc, "status_code", None) or getattr(getattr(exc, "response", None), "status_code", None)
+                if status != 429:
+                    raise
+                headers = getattr(exc, "headers", None) or getattr(getattr(exc, "response", None), "headers", {})
+                delay = self._retry_after(headers)
+                self._bucket.defer(delay)
+                retries += 1
+                if retries > 3:
+                    raise PollingError("Alpaca remained rate limited after retries") from exc
+                continue
+            status = getattr(response, "status_code", None)
+            if status == 429:
+                delay = self._retry_after(getattr(response, "headers", {}))
+                self._bucket.defer(delay)
+                retries += 1
+                if retries > 3:
+                    raise PollingError("Alpaca remained rate limited after retries")
+                continue
+            if status is not None and status >= 400:
+                raise PollingError(f"Alpaca request failed with HTTP {status}")
+            return response.json() if callable(getattr(response, "json", None)) else response
+
+    def _retry_after(self, headers: Mapping[str, Any]) -> float:
+        value = next((v for k, v in headers.items() if str(k).lower() == "retry-after"), None)
+        if value is None:
+            return 1.0
+        try:
+            return max(0.0, float(value))
+        except (TypeError, ValueError):
+            try:
+                return max(0.0, (email.utils.parsedate_to_datetime(str(value)).astimezone(UTC)
+                                 - _utc(self._clock.now(), "clock")).total_seconds())
+            except (TypeError, ValueError, OverflowError):
+                return 1.0
+
+    def poll_cycle(self, symbols: Sequence[str]) -> tuple[PollSnapshot, ...]:
+        cleaned = tuple(dict.fromkeys(s.strip().upper() for s in symbols))
+        if not cleaned or any(not s for s in cleaned):
+            raise ValueError("symbols must be non-empty")
+        if len(cleaned) > self.max_symbols_per_cycle:
+            raise ValueError("symbol count exceeds max_symbols_per_cycle")
+        snapshots: list[PollSnapshot] = []
+        for kind in self.kinds:
+            data = self._get(self._ENDPOINTS[kind], {"symbols": ",".join(cleaned), "feed": self.feed})
+            if not isinstance(data, Mapping):
+                raise PollingError("latest snapshot response must be an object")
+            field = {PollKind.TRADE: "trades", PollKind.QUOTE: "quotes", PollKind.BAR: "bars"}[kind]
+            records = data.get(field, {})
+            if not isinstance(records, Mapping):
+                raise PollingError(f"response {field} must be an object keyed by symbol")
+            receive_ts = _utc(self._clock.now(), "clock")
+            for symbol in cleaned:
+                item = records.get(symbol)
+                if item is None:
+                    continue
+                if not isinstance(item, Mapping):
+                    raise PollingError("snapshot item must be an object")
+                source_ts = _parse_ts(item.get("t"))
+                feed_id = str(item.get("feed_id", item.get("feed", self.feed))).lower()
+                if feed_id != self.feed:
+                    raise PollingError("snapshot feed differs from configured feed")
+                key = (symbol, kind)
+                stale = source_ts <= self._last_ts.get(key, source_ts - timedelta(microseconds=1))
+                stale = stale or (receive_ts - source_ts).total_seconds() > self.stale_after_seconds
+                self._last_ts[key] = source_ts
+                values = {k: (_dec(v) if k in {"p", "s", "bp", "bs", "ap", "as", "o", "h", "l", "c", "v", "vw"} else v)
+                          for k, v in item.items() if k not in {"t", "feed", "feed_id"}}
+                snapshots.append(PollSnapshot(symbol, kind, source_ts, receive_ts,
+                                              feed_id, "rest_poll", stale, values))
+        return tuple(snapshots)
+
+    def recover_gap(self, symbol: str, timeframe: str, start: datetime,
+                    end: datetime) -> tuple[HistoricalBar, ...]:
+        start_utc, end_utc = _utc(start, "start"), _utc(end, "end")
+        if end_utc <= start_utc:
+            raise ValueError("gap end must be after start")
+        if end_utc - start_utc > self.max_gap:
+            raise ValueError("gap window exceeds configured maximum")
+        return AlpacaHistoricalBars(_LimitedClient(self), max_pages=20).fetch_bars(
+            symbol, timeframe, start_utc, end_utc, feed=self.feed, adjustment="raw")

+"""Offline contract tests for historical acquisition and bounded REST polling."""
+

+from mike_trade.market_data.alpaca_history import (

+    AlpacaHistoricalBars,

+    PaginationLimitError,

+)
+from mike_trade.market_data.polling import PollKind, RestMarketDataPoller, TokenBucket
+
+
+T0 = datetime(2026, 1, 2, 15, 0, tzinfo=UTC)
+
+
+def bar(timestamp: str, **extra: object) -> dict[str, object]:
+    return {"t": timestamp, "o": 10.1, "h": 11.2, "l": 9.9, "c": 10.5,
+            "v": 100, "vw": 10.4, "n": 12, **extra}
+
+
+class Pages:
+    def __init__(self, pages: list[dict[str, object]]) -> None:
+        self.pages = pages
+        self.calls: list[tuple[str, dict[str, object] | None]] = []
+
+    def get(self, path: str, params: dict[str, object] | None = None) -> dict[str, object]:
+        self.calls.append((path, params))
+        return self.pages[len(self.calls) - 1]
+
+
+def test_history_paginates_orders_bars_and_preserves_decimal_types() -> None:
+    client = Pages([
+        {"bars": [bar("2026-01-02T15:01:00Z")], "next_page_token": "p2"},
+        {"bars": [bar("2026-01-02T15:00:00Z")], "next_page_token": None},
+    ])
+    bars = AlpacaHistoricalBars(client).fetch_bars(
+        "aapl", "1Min", T0, T0 + timedelta(minutes=3), adjustment="split")
+    assert len(client.calls) == 2
+    assert client.calls[1][1]["page_token"] == "p2"  # type: ignore[index]
+    assert [item.timestamp for item in bars] == sorted(item.timestamp for item in bars)
+    assert bars[0].timestamp.tzinfo is UTC
+    assert bars[0].feed_id == "iex" and bars[0].adjustment is Adjustment.SPLIT
+    for item in bars:
+        assert all(isinstance(getattr(item, field), Decimal)
+                   for field in ("open", "high", "low", "close", "vwap"))
+        assert isinstance(item.volume, (int, Decimal))
+        assert not any(isinstance(getattr(item, field.name), float) for field in fields(item))
+
+
+def test_history_honors_page_bound() -> None:
+    client = Pages([{"bars": [], "next_page_token": "again"}] * 3)
+    with pytest.raises(PaginationLimitError):
+        AlpacaHistoricalBars(client, max_pages=2).fetch_bars(
+            "AAPL", "1Min", T0, T0 + timedelta(minutes=1))
+    assert len(client.calls) == 2
+
+
+def test_mixed_feed_or_adjustment_provenance_is_rejected() -> None:
+    first = HistoricalBar("AAPL", T0, Decimal("1"), Decimal("2"), Decimal("1"),
+                          Decimal("2"), 1, Decimal("1.5"), 1, "iex", Adjustment.RAW)
+    second = HistoricalBar("AAPL", T0, Decimal("1"), Decimal("2"), Decimal("1"),

+
+class FakeClock:
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self.value = T0
+
+    def now(self) -> datetime:
+        return self.value
+
+    def sleep(self, seconds: float) -> None:
+        self.value += timedelta(seconds=seconds)
+
+
+class PollTransport:
+    def __init__(self, clock: FakeClock, *, rate_limit: bool = False) -> None:
+        self.clock = clock
+        self.calls: list[tuple[str, dict[str, object] | None]] = []
+        self.rate_limit = rate_limit
+        self.fixed_ts: datetime | None = None
+
+    def get(self, path: str, params: dict[str, object] | None = None) -> object:
+        self.calls.append((path, params))
+        if self.rate_limit and len(self.calls) == 1:
+            return Response(429, {"Retry-After": "3"})
+        key = "trades"
+        if "/quotes/" in path:
+            key = "quotes"
+        elif "/bars/" in path:
+            key = "bars"
+        timestamp = (self.fixed_ts or self.clock.now()).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
+        payload = {"t": timestamp, "feed_id": "iex", "p": "10.25", "s": 2}
+        return {key: {"AAPL": payload, "MSFT": payload}}
+
+
+class Response:
+    def __init__(self, status_code: int, headers: dict[str, str]) -> None:
+        self.status_code = status_code
+        self.headers = headers
+
+
+def test_poll_cycle_batches_symbols_instead_of_polling_per_consumer() -> None:

+    client = PollTransport(clock)
+    poller = RestMarketDataPoller(client, clock=clock, sleep=clock.sleep, kinds=(PollKind.TRADE,))
+    snapshots = poller.poll_cycle(["AAPL", "MSFT"])
+    assert len(client.calls) == 1
+    assert client.calls[0][1]["symbols"] == "AAPL,MSFT"  # type: ignore[index]
+    assert len(snapshots) == 2
+    assert all(s.source == "rest_poll" and s.feed_id == "iex" for s in snapshots)
+
+
+def test_token_bucket_defers_and_retry_after_delays_next_request() -> None:
+    clock = FakeClock()
+    delays: list[float] = []
+
+    def sleep(seconds: float) -> None:
+        delays.append(seconds)
+        clock.sleep(seconds)
+
+    limited = PollTransport(clock, rate_limit=True)
+    poller = RestMarketDataPoller(limited, clock=clock, sleep=sleep, requests_per_second=1,
+                                  burst=1, kinds=(PollKind.TRADE,))
+    poller.poll_cycle(["AAPL"])
+    assert any(delay >= 3 for delay in delays)
+    bucket = TokenBucket(capacity=1, refill_per_second=1, clock=clock.now, sleep=sleep)
+    before = clock.now()
+    bucket.acquire()
+    bucket.acquire()
+    assert (clock.now() - before).total_seconds() >= 1
+
+
+def test_unchanged_or_old_provider_timestamp_is_stale() -> None:
+    clock = FakeClock()
+    client = PollTransport(clock)
+    poller = RestMarketDataPoller(client, clock=clock, sleep=clock.sleep,
+                                  kinds=(PollKind.TRADE,), stale_after_seconds=2)
+    first = poller.poll_cycle(["AAPL"])[0]
+    second = poller.poll_cycle(["AAPL"])[0]
+    assert not first.stale
+    assert second.stale
+    clock.value += timedelta(seconds=3)
+    client.fixed_ts = T0
+    old = poller.poll_cycle(["AAPL"])[0]
+    assert old.stale
+
+
+def test_gap_recovery_is_bounded_and_uses_only_requested_window() -> None:
+    clock = FakeClock()
+    client = Pages([{"bars": [bar("2026-01-02T15:01:00Z")]}])
+    poller = RestMarketDataPoller(client, clock=clock, sleep=clock.sleep,
+                                  kinds=(PollKind.BAR,), max_gap=timedelta(minutes=5))
+    recovered = poller.recover_gap("AAPL", "1Min", T0, T0 + timedelta(minutes=2))
+    assert len(recovered) == 1
+    params = client.calls[0][1]
+    assert params["start"] == "2026-01-02T15:00:00Z"  # type: ignore[index]
+    assert params["end"] == "2026-01-02T15:02:00Z"  # type: ignore[index]
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="maximum"):
+        poller.recover_gap("AAPL", "1Min", T0, T0 + timedelta(minutes=6))

+"""Bounded, provenance-aware Alpaca historical stock bar acquisition."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Mapping
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
+from enum import StrEnum
+from typing import Any
+
+__all__ = ["Adjustment", "HistoricalBar", "AlpacaHistoryError", "BarProvenanceError",
+           "PaginationLimitError", "AlpacaHistoricalBars", "merge_bars"]
+
+
+class Adjustment(StrEnum):
+    RAW = "raw"
+    SPLIT = "split"
+    DIVIDEND = "dividend"
+    ALL = "all"
+
+
+class AlpacaHistoryError(ValueError):
+    """Invalid or incomplete Alpaca historical data response."""
+
+
+class BarProvenanceError(AlpacaHistoryError):
+    """Bars in a request or merge do not share feed and adjustment provenance."""
+
+
+class PaginationLimitError(AlpacaHistoryError):
+    """The response still has another page after the configured page limit."""
+
+
+def _utc(value: datetime, field: str) -> datetime:
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a timezone-aware datetime")
+    return value.astimezone(UTC)
+
+
+def _decimal(value: Any, field: str) -> Decimal:
+    if isinstance(value, bool):
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be numeric")
+    try:
+        result = value if isinstance(value, Decimal) else Decimal(str(value))
+    except (InvalidOperation, ValueError, TypeError):
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be numeric") from None
+    if not result.is_finite():
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be finite")
+    return result
+
+
+def _count(value: Any, field: str) -> int | Decimal:
+    if isinstance(value, bool):
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be integer or Decimal")
+    if isinstance(value, float):
+        return _decimal(value, field)
+    if isinstance(value, int):
+        return value
+    return _decimal(value, field)
+
+
+def _timestamp(value: Any) -> datetime:
+    if not isinstance(value, str):
+        raise ValueError("bar timestamp must be an ISO timestamp string")
+    text = value[:-1] + "+00:00" if value.endswith("Z") else value
+    try:
+        return _utc(datetime.fromisoformat(text), "bar timestamp")
+    except ValueError as exc:
+        raise ValueError("bar timestamp must be ISO formatted and timezone-aware") from exc
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class HistoricalBar:
+    symbol: str
+    timestamp: datetime
+    open: Decimal
+    high: Decimal
+    low: Decimal
+    close: Decimal
+    volume: int | Decimal
+    vwap: Decimal | None
+    trade_count: int | Decimal | None
+    feed_id: str
+    adjustment: Adjustment
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        symbol = self.symbol.strip().upper() if isinstance(self.symbol, str) else ""
+        if not symbol:
+            raise ValueError("symbol must be non-empty")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol", symbol)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "timestamp", _utc(self.timestamp, "timestamp"))
+        for field in ("open", "high", "low", "close"):
+            object.__setattr__(self, field, _decimal(getattr(self, field), field))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "volume", _count(self.volume, "volume"))
+        if self.vwap is not None:
+            object.__setattr__(self, "vwap", _decimal(self.vwap, "vwap"))
+        if self.trade_count is not None:
+            object.__setattr__(self, "trade_count", _count(self.trade_count, "trade_count"))
+        if not isinstance(self.feed_id, str) or not self.feed_id.strip():
+            raise ValueError("feed_id must be non-empty")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "feed_id", self.feed_id.strip().lower())
+        if not isinstance(self.adjustment, Adjustment):
+            object.__setattr__(self, "adjustment", Adjustment(self.adjustment))
+
+    @property
+    def adjustment_provenance(self) -> Adjustment:
+        """Explicitly named alias for the requested adjustment mode."""
+        return self.adjustment
+
+
+def merge_bars(*groups: tuple[HistoricalBar, ...] | list[HistoricalBar]) -> tuple[HistoricalBar, ...]:
+    """Merge bars only when every input shares the exact feed and adjustment."""
+    bars = [bar for group in groups for bar in group]
+    if not bars:
+        return ()
+    provenance = {(bar.feed_id, bar.adjustment) for bar in bars}
+    if len(provenance) != 1:
+        raise BarProvenanceError("cannot merge bars from different feeds or adjustments")
+    return tuple(sorted(bars, key=lambda bar: (bar.timestamp, bar.symbol)))
+
+
+class AlpacaHistoricalBars:
+    """Fetch historical bars using an injected object exposing ``get(path, params)``."""
+
+    def __init__(self, client: Any, *, max_pages: int = 20) -> None:
+        if not callable(getattr(client, "get", None)):
+            raise TypeError("client must expose get(path, params)")
+        if isinstance(max_pages, bool) or not isinstance(max_pages, int) or max_pages < 1:
+            raise ValueError("max_pages must be a positive integer")
+        self._client = client
+        self.max_pages = max_pages
+
+    def fetch_bars(
+        self, symbol: str, timeframe: Any, start: datetime, end: datetime, *,
+        feed: str = "iex", adjustment: Adjustment | str = Adjustment.RAW,
+    ) -> tuple[HistoricalBar, ...]:
+        symbol = symbol.strip().upper()
+        feed = feed.strip().lower()
+        try:
+            adjustment = Adjustment(adjustment)
+        except ValueError:
+            raise ValueError("adjustment must be raw, split, dividend, or all") from None
+        start_utc, end_utc = _utc(start, "start"), _utc(end, "end")
+        if start_utc >= end_utc:
+            raise ValueError("start must be before end")
+        timeframe_value = getattr(timeframe, "value", timeframe)
+        if not symbol or not feed or not isinstance(timeframe_value, str) or not timeframe_value.strip():
+            raise ValueError("symbol, timeframe, and feed must be non-empty")
+        timeframe_value = {
+            "1m": "1Min", "5m": "5Min", "15m": "15Min", "1h": "1Hour", "1d": "1Day",
+        }.get(timeframe_value.strip().lower(), timeframe_value.strip())
+        params: dict[str, Any] = {
+            "symbols": symbol, "timeframe": timeframe_value,
+            "start": start_utc.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z"),
+            "end": end_utc.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z"),
+            "feed": feed, "adjustment": adjustment.value,
+        }
+        token: str | None = None
+        bars: list[HistoricalBar] = []
+        for page in range(self.max_pages):
+            if token is not None:
+                params["page_token"] = token
+            data = self._client.get("/v2/stocks/bars", params=params.copy())
+            if not isinstance(data, Mapping):
+                raise AlpacaHistoryError("historical bars response must be an object")
+            response_feed = data.get("feed")
+            response_adjustment = data.get("adjustment")
+            if response_feed is not None and str(response_feed).lower() != feed:
+                raise BarProvenanceError("response feed differs from requested feed")
+            if response_adjustment is not None and str(response_adjustment).lower() != adjustment.value:
+                raise BarProvenanceError("response adjustment differs from requested adjustment")
+            result = data.get("bars")
+            if isinstance(result, Mapping):
+                result = result.get(symbol)
+            if not isinstance(result, list):
+                raise AlpacaHistoryError("historical bars response must contain a bars array")
+            for item in result:
+                if not isinstance(item, Mapping):
+                    raise AlpacaHistoryError("bar item must be an object")
+                item_feed = item.get("feed_id", item.get("feed", feed))
+                item_adjustment = item.get("adjustment", adjustment.value)
+                if str(item_feed).lower() != feed or str(item_adjustment).lower() != adjustment.value:
+                    raise BarProvenanceError("bar provenance differs from request")
+                bars.append(HistoricalBar(
+                    symbol=symbol, timestamp=_timestamp(item.get("t")),
+                    open=_decimal(item.get("o"), "open"), high=_decimal(item.get("h"), "high"),
+                    low=_decimal(item.get("l"), "low"), close=_decimal(item.get("c"), "close"),
+                    volume=_count(item.get("v"), "volume"),
+                    vwap=None if item.get("vw") is None else _decimal(item["vw"], "vwap"),
+                    trade_count=None if item.get("n") is None else _count(item["n"], "trade_count"),
+                    feed_id=feed, adjustment=adjustment,
+                ))
+            token = data.get("next_page_token")
+            if not token:
+                break
+        else:
+            raise PaginationLimitError(f"historical response exceeds max_pages={self.max_pages}")
+        return tuple(sorted(bars, key=lambda bar: bar.timestamp))

+"""Bounded REST polling fallback for the shared market-data service."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import email.utils
+import time
+from collections.abc import Mapping, Sequence
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
+from decimal import Decimal
+from types import MappingProxyType
+from typing import Any, Callable
+
+from mike_trade.market_data.alpaca_history import AlpacaHistoricalBars, HistoricalBar
+
+__all__ = ["PollKind", "PollSnapshot", "TokenBucket", "PollingError", "RestMarketDataPoller"]
+
+
+class PollKind:
+    TRADE = "trade"
+    QUOTE = "quote"
+    BAR = "bar"
+
+
+def _utc(value: datetime, name: str) -> datetime:
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a timezone-aware datetime")
+    return value.astimezone(UTC)
+
+
+def _parse_ts(value: Any) -> datetime:
+    if isinstance(value, datetime):
+        return _utc(value, "provider timestamp")
+    if not isinstance(value, str):
+        raise ValueError("provider timestamp must be ISO formatted")
+    text = value[:-1] + "+00:00" if value.endswith("Z") else value
+    return _utc(datetime.fromisoformat(text), "provider timestamp")
+
+
+def _dec(value: Any) -> Decimal | int | None:
+    if value is None:
+        return None
+    if isinstance(value, (int, Decimal)) and not isinstance(value, bool):
+        return value
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        return Decimal(value)
+    raise ValueError("snapshot numeric values must be int, Decimal, or string")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class PollSnapshot:
+    symbol: str
+    kind: str
+    provider_source_ts: datetime
+    receive_ts: datetime
+    feed_id: str
+    source: str
+    stale: bool
+    values: Mapping[str, Any]
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol", self.symbol.strip().upper())
+        object.__setattr__(self, "provider_source_ts", _utc(self.provider_source_ts, "provider_source_ts"))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "receive_ts", _utc(self.receive_ts, "receive_ts"))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "values", MappingProxyType(dict(self.values)))
+
+
+class PollingError(RuntimeError):
+    pass
+
+
+class TokenBucket:
+    """Synchronous token bucket driven by an injected datetime clock and sleeper."""
+
+    def __init__(self, *, capacity: float, refill_per_second: float,
+                 clock: Callable[[], datetime], sleep: Callable[[float], None] = time.sleep) -> None:
+        if capacity < 1 or refill_per_second <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("capacity and refill_per_second must be positive")
+        self.capacity = float(capacity)
+        self.refill_per_second = float(refill_per_second)
+        self._clock = clock
+        self._sleep = sleep
+        self._tokens = float(capacity)
+        self._updated = _utc(clock(), "clock")
+        self._blocked_until = self._updated
+
+    def defer(self, seconds: float) -> None:
+        if seconds > 0:
+            self._blocked_until = max(self._blocked_until, _utc(self._clock(), "clock") + timedelta(seconds=seconds))
+
+    def acquire(self) -> None:
+        while True:
+            now = _utc(self._clock(), "clock")
+            if now < self._blocked_until:
+                self._sleep((self._blocked_until - now).total_seconds())
+                continue
+            elapsed = max(0.0, (now - self._updated).total_seconds())
+            self._tokens = min(self.capacity, self._tokens + elapsed * self.refill_per_second)
+            self._updated = now
+            if self._tokens >= 1:
+                self._tokens -= 1
+                return
+            self._sleep((1 - self._tokens) / self.refill_per_second)
+
+
+class _LimitedClient:
+    def __init__(self, poller: "RestMarketDataPoller") -> None:
+        self._poller = poller
+
+    def get(self, path: str, params: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None) -> Any:
+        return self._poller._get(path, params)
+
+
+class RestMarketDataPoller:
+    """Fetch each watched symbol once per market-data kind in one batched call."""
+
+    _ENDPOINTS = {
+        PollKind.TRADE: "/v2/stocks/trades/latest",
+        PollKind.QUOTE: "/v2/stocks/quotes/latest",
+        PollKind.BAR: "/v2/stocks/bars/latest",
+    }
+
+    def __init__(self, client: Any, *, clock: Any, feed: str = "iex",
+                 requests_per_second: float = 5.0, burst: int = 5,
+                 poll_interval_seconds: float = 1.0, max_poll_interval_seconds: float = 60.0,
+                 max_symbols_per_cycle: int = 100, stale_after_seconds: float = 30.0,
+                 max_gap: timedelta = timedelta(hours=1), sleep: Callable[[float], None] = time.sleep,
+                 kinds: Sequence[str] = (PollKind.TRADE, PollKind.QUOTE, PollKind.BAR)) -> None:
+        if not callable(getattr(client, "get", None)):
+            raise TypeError("client must expose get(path, params)")
+        if not callable(getattr(clock, "now", None)):
+            raise TypeError("clock must expose now()")
+        if poll_interval_seconds <= 0 or max_poll_interval_seconds <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("poll intervals must be positive")
+        if max_symbols_per_cycle < 1 or stale_after_seconds < 0 or max_gap <= timedelta(0):
+            raise ValueError("poll bounds must be positive")
+        if any(kind not in self._ENDPOINTS for kind in kinds) or not kinds:
+            raise ValueError("kinds must contain trade, quote, and/or bar")
+        self._client, self._clock, self.feed = client, clock, feed.strip().lower()
+        self.poll_interval_seconds = min(poll_interval_seconds, max_poll_interval_seconds)
+        self.max_poll_interval_seconds = max_poll_interval_seconds
+        self.max_symbols_per_cycle = max_symbols_per_cycle
+        self.stale_after_seconds = stale_after_seconds
+        self.max_gap = max_gap
+        self.kinds = tuple(dict.fromkeys(kinds))
+        self._bucket = TokenBucket(capacity=burst, refill_per_second=requests_per_second,
+                                   clock=clock.now, sleep=sleep)
+        self._last_ts: dict[tuple[str, str], datetime] = {}
+        self._retry_until: datetime | None = None
+        self._sleep = sleep
+
+    def _get(self, path: str, params: Mapping[str, Any] | None) -> Any:
+        retries = 0
+        while True:
+            self._bucket.acquire()
+            try:
+                response = self._client.get(path, params=dict(params) if params else None)
+            except Exception as exc:
+                status = getattr(exc, "status_code", None) or getattr(getattr(exc, "response", None), "status_code", None)
+                if status != 429:
+                    raise
+                headers = getattr(exc, "headers", None) or getattr(getattr(exc, "response", None), "headers", {})
+                delay = self._retry_after(headers)
+                self._bucket.defer(delay)
+                retries += 1
+                if retries > 3:
+                    raise PollingError("Alpaca remained rate limited after retries") from exc
+                continue
+            status = getattr(response, "status_code", None)
+            if status == 429:
+                delay = self._retry_after(getattr(response, "headers", {}))
+                self._bucket.defer(delay)
+                retries += 1
+                if retries > 3:
+                    raise PollingError("Alpaca remained rate limited after retries")
+                continue
+            if status is not None and status >= 400:
+                raise PollingError(f"Alpaca request failed with HTTP {status}")
+            return response.json() if callable(getattr(response, "json", None)) else response
+
+    def _retry_after(self, headers: Mapping[str, Any]) -> float:
+        value = next((v for k, v in headers.items() if str(k).lower() == "retry-after"), None)
+        if value is None:
+            return 1.0
+        try:
+            return max(0.0, float(value))
+        except (TypeError, ValueError):
+            try:
+                return max(0.0, (email.utils.parsedate_to_datetime(str(value)).astimezone(UTC)
+                                 - _utc(self._clock.now(), "clock")).total_seconds())
+            except (TypeError, ValueError, OverflowError):
+                return 1.0
+
+    def poll_cycle(self, symbols: Sequence[str]) -> tuple[PollSnapshot, ...]:
+        cleaned = tuple(dict.fromkeys(s.strip().upper() for s in symbols))
+        if not cleaned or any(not s for s in cleaned):
+            raise ValueError("symbols must be non-empty")
+        if len(cleaned) > self.max_symbols_per_cycle:
+            raise ValueError("symbol count exceeds max_symbols_per_cycle")
+        snapshots: list[PollSnapshot] = []
+        for kind in self.kinds:
+            data = self._get(self._ENDPOINTS[kind], {"symbols": ",".join(cleaned), "feed": self.feed})
+            if not isinstance(data, Mapping):
+                raise PollingError("latest snapshot response must be an object")
+            field = {PollKind.TRADE: "trades", PollKind.QUOTE: "quotes", PollKind.BAR: "bars"}[kind]
+            records = data.get(field, {})
+            if not isinstance(records, Mapping):
+                raise PollingError(f"response {field} must be an object keyed by symbol")
+            receive_ts = _utc(self._clock.now(), "clock")
+            for symbol in cleaned:
+                item = records.get(symbol)
+                if item is None:
+                    continue
+                if not isinstance(item, Mapping):
+                    raise PollingError("snapshot item must be an object")
+                source_ts = _parse_ts(item.get("t"))
+                feed_id = str(item.get("feed_id", item.get("feed", self.feed))).lower()
+                if feed_id != self.feed:
+                    raise PollingError("snapshot feed differs from configured feed")
+                key = (symbol, kind)
+                stale = source_ts <= self._last_ts.get(key, source_ts - timedelta(microseconds=1))
+                stale = stale or (receive_ts - source_ts).total_seconds() > self.stale_after_seconds
+                self._last_ts[key] = source_ts
+                values = {k: (_dec(v) if k in {"p", "s", "bp", "bs", "ap", "as", "o", "h", "l", "c", "v", "vw"} else v)
+                          for k, v in item.items() if k not in {"t", "feed", "feed_id"}}
+                snapshots.append(PollSnapshot(symbol, kind, source_ts, receive_ts,
+                                              feed_id, "rest_poll", stale, values))
+        return tuple(snapshots)
+
+    def recover_gap(self, symbol: str, timeframe: str, start: datetime,
+                    end: datetime) -> tuple[HistoricalBar, ...]:
+        start_utc, end_utc = _utc(start, "start"), _utc(end, "end")
+        if end_utc <= start_utc:
+            raise ValueError("gap end must be after start")
+        if end_utc - start_utc > self.max_gap:
+            raise ValueError("gap window exceeds configured maximum")
+        return AlpacaHistoricalBars(_LimitedClient(self), max_pages=20).fetch_bars(
+            symbol, timeframe, start_utc, end_utc, feed=self.feed, adjustment="raw")

+"""Offline contract tests for historical acquisition and bounded REST polling."""
+
+from dataclasses import fields
+from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
+from decimal import Decimal
+
+import pytest
+
+from mike_trade.market_data.alpaca_history import (
+    Adjustment,
+    AlpacaHistoricalBars,
+    BarProvenanceError,
+    HistoricalBar,
+    PaginationLimitError,
+    merge_bars,
+)
+from mike_trade.market_data.polling import PollKind, RestMarketDataPoller, TokenBucket
+
+
+T0 = datetime(2026, 1, 2, 15, 0, tzinfo=UTC)
+
+
+def bar(timestamp: str, **extra: object) -> dict[str, object]:
+    return {"t": timestamp, "o": 10.1, "h": 11.2, "l": 9.9, "c": 10.5,
+            "v": 100, "vw": 10.4, "n": 12, **extra}
+
+
+class Pages:
+    def __init__(self, pages: list[dict[str, object]]) -> None:
+        self.pages = pages
+        self.calls: list[tuple[str, dict[str, object] | None]] = []
+
+    def get(self, path: str, params: dict[str, object] | None = None) -> dict[str, object]:
+        self.calls.append((path, params))
+        return self.pages[len(self.calls) - 1]
+
+
+def test_history_paginates_orders_bars_and_preserves_decimal_types() -> None:
+    client = Pages([
+        {"bars": [bar("2026-01-02T15:01:00Z")], "next_page_token": "p2"},
+        {"bars": [bar("2026-01-02T15:00:00Z")], "next_page_token": None},
+    ])
+    bars = AlpacaHistoricalBars(client).fetch_bars(
+        "aapl", "1Min", T0, T0 + timedelta(minutes=3), adjustment="split")
+    assert len(client.calls) == 2
+    assert client.calls[1][1]["page_token"] == "p2"  # type: ignore[index]
+    assert [item.timestamp for item in bars] == sorted(item.timestamp for item in bars)
+    assert bars[0].timestamp.tzinfo is UTC
+    assert bars[0].feed_id == "iex" and bars[0].adjustment is Adjustment.SPLIT
+    for item in bars:
+        assert all(isinstance(getattr(item, field), Decimal)
+                   for field in ("open", "high", "low", "close", "vwap"))
+        assert isinstance(item.volume, (int, Decimal))
+        assert not any(isinstance(getattr(item, field.name), float) for field in fields(item))
+
+
+def test_history_honors_page_bound() -> None:
+    client = Pages([{"bars": [], "next_page_token": "again"}] * 3)
+    with pytest.raises(PaginationLimitError):
+        AlpacaHistoricalBars(client, max_pages=2).fetch_bars(
+            "AAPL", "1Min", T0, T0 + timedelta(minutes=1))
+    assert len(client.calls) == 2
+
+
+def test_mixed_feed_or_adjustment_provenance_is_rejected() -> None:
+    first = HistoricalBar("AAPL", T0, Decimal("1"), Decimal("2"), Decimal("1"),
+                          Decimal("2"), 1, Decimal("1.5"), 1, "iex", Adjustment.RAW)
+    second = HistoricalBar("AAPL", T0, Decimal("1"), Decimal("2"), Decimal("1"),
+                           Decimal("2"), 1, Decimal("1.5"), 1, "sip", Adjustment.RAW)
+    with pytest.raises(BarProvenanceError):
+        merge_bars([first], [second])
+    client = Pages([{"feed": "sip", "bars": []}])
+    with pytest.raises(BarProvenanceError):
+        AlpacaHistoricalBars(client).fetch_bars("AAPL", "1Min", T0, T0 + timedelta(minutes=1))
+
+
+class FakeClock:
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self.value = T0
+
+    def now(self) -> datetime:
+        return self.value
+
+    def sleep(self, seconds: float) -> None:
+        self.value += timedelta(seconds=seconds)
+
+
+class PollTransport:
+    def __init__(self, clock: FakeClock, *, rate_limit: bool = False) -> None:
+        self.clock = clock
+        self.calls: list[tuple[str, dict[str, object] | None]] = []
+        self.rate_limit = rate_limit
+        self.fixed_ts: datetime | None = None
+
+    def get(self, path: str, params: dict[str, object] | None = None) -> object:
+        self.calls.append((path, params))
+        if self.rate_limit and len(self.calls) == 1:
+            return Response(429, {"Retry-After": "3"})
+        key = "trades"
+        if "/quotes/" in path:
+            key = "quotes"
+        elif "/bars/" in path:
+            key = "bars"
+        timestamp = (self.fixed_ts or self.clock.now()).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
+        payload = {"t": timestamp, "feed_id": "iex", "p": "10.25", "s": 2}
+        return {key: {"AAPL": payload, "MSFT": payload}}
+
+
+class Response:
+    def __init__(self, status_code: int, headers: dict[str, str]) -> None:
+        self.status_code = status_code
+        self.headers = headers
+
+
+def test_poll_cycle_batches_symbols_instead_of_polling_per_consumer() -> None:
+    clock = FakeClock()
+    client = PollTransport(clock)
+    poller = RestMarketDataPoller(client, clock=clock, sleep=clock.sleep, kinds=(PollKind.TRADE,))
+    snapshots = poller.poll_cycle(["AAPL", "MSFT"])
+    assert len(client.calls) == 1

+"""Bounded REST polling fallback for the shared market-data service."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import email.utils
+import time
+from collections.abc import Mapping, Sequence
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
+from decimal import Decimal
+from types import MappingProxyType
+from typing import Any, Callable
+
+from mike_trade.market_data.alpaca_history import AlpacaHistoricalBars, HistoricalBar
+
+__all__ = ["PollKind", "PollSnapshot", "TokenBucket", "PollingError", "RestMarketDataPoller"]
+
+
+class PollKind:
+    TRADE = "trade"
+    QUOTE = "quote"
+    BAR = "bar"
+
+
+def _utc(value: datetime, name: str) -> datetime:
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a timezone-aware datetime")
+    return value.astimezone(UTC)
+
+
+def _parse_ts(value: Any) -> datetime:
+    if isinstance(value, datetime):
+        return _utc(value, "provider timestamp")
+    if not isinstance(value, str):
+        raise ValueError("provider timestamp must be ISO formatted")
+    text = value[:-1] + "+00:00" if value.endswith("Z") else value
+    return _utc(datetime.fromisoformat(text), "provider timestamp")
+
+
+def _dec(value: Any) -> Decimal | int | None:
+    if value is None:
+        return None
+    if isinstance(value, (int, Decimal)) and not isinstance(value, bool):
+        return value
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        return Decimal(value)
+    raise ValueError("snapshot numeric values must be int, Decimal, or string")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class PollSnapshot:
+    symbol: str
+    kind: str
+    provider_source_ts: datetime
+    receive_ts: datetime
+    feed_id: str
+    source: str
+    stale: bool
+    values: Mapping[str, Any]
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol", self.symbol.strip().upper())
+        object.__setattr__(self, "provider_source_ts", _utc(self.provider_source_ts, "provider_source_ts"))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "receive_ts", _utc(self.receive_ts, "receive_ts"))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "values", MappingProxyType(dict(self.values)))
+
+
+class PollingError(RuntimeError):
+    pass
+
+
+class TokenBucket:
+    """Synchronous token bucket driven by an injected datetime clock and sleeper."""
+
+    def __init__(self, *, capacity: float, refill_per_second: float,
+                 clock: Callable[[], datetime], sleep: Callable[[float], None] = time.sleep) -> None:
+        if capacity < 1 or refill_per_second <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("capacity and refill_per_second must be positive")
+        self.capacity = float(capacity)
+        self.refill_per_second = float(refill_per_second)
+        self._clock = clock
+        self._sleep = sleep
+        self._tokens = float(capacity)
+        self._updated = _utc(clock(), "clock")
+        self._blocked_until = self._updated
+
+    def defer(self, seconds: float) -> None:
+        if seconds > 0:
+            self._blocked_until = max(self._blocked_until, _utc(self._clock(), "clock") + timedelta(seconds=seconds))
+
+    def acquire(self) -> None:
+        while True:
+            now = _utc(self._clock(), "clock")
+            if now < self._blocked_until:

+class RestMarketDataPoller:
+    """Fetch each watched symbol once per market-data kind in one batched call."""
+
+    _ENDPOINTS = {
+        PollKind.TRADE: "/v2/stocks/trades/latest",
+        PollKind.QUOTE: "/v2/stocks/quotes/latest",
+        PollKind.BAR: "/v2/stocks/bars/latest",
+    }
+
+    def __init__(self, client: Any, *, clock: Any, feed: str = "iex",
+                 requests_per_second: float = 5.0, burst: int = 5,
+                 poll_interval_seconds: float = 1.0, max_poll_interval_seconds: float = 60.0,
+                 max_symbols_per_cycle: int = 100, stale_after_seconds: float = 30.0,
+                 max_gap: timedelta = timedelta(hours=1), sleep: Callable[[float], None] = time.sleep,
+                 kinds: Sequence[str] = (PollKind.TRADE, PollKind.QUOTE, PollKind.BAR)) -> None:
+        if not callable(getattr(client, "get", None)):
+            raise TypeError("client must expose get(path, params)")
+        if not callable(getattr(clock, "now", None)):
+            raise TypeError("clock must expose now()")

+            raise ValueError("poll intervals must be positive")

+            raise ValueError("poll bounds must be positive")
+        if any(kind not in self._ENDPOINTS for kind in kinds) or not kinds:
+            raise ValueError("kinds must contain trade, quote, and/or bar")

+        self.poll_interval_seconds = min(poll_interval_seconds, max_poll_interval_seconds)
+        self.max_poll_interval_seconds = max_poll_interval_seconds
+        self.max_symbols_per_cycle = max_symbols_per_cycle
+        self.stale_after_seconds = stale_after_seconds
+        self.max_gap = max_gap
+        self.kinds = tuple(dict.fromkeys(kinds))
+        self._bucket = TokenBucket(capacity=burst, refill_per_second=requests_per_second,
+                                   clock=clock.now, sleep=sleep)
+        self._last_ts: dict[tuple[str, str], datetime] = {}
+        self._retry_until: datetime | None = None
+        self._sleep = sleep
+
+    def _get(self, path: str, params: Mapping[str, Any] | None) -> Any:
+        retries = 0

+            self._bucket.acquire()

+                if retries > 3:
+                    raise PollingError("Alpaca remained rate limited after retries") from exc
+                continue
+            status = getattr(response, "status_code", None)
+            if status == 429:
+                delay = self._retry_after(getattr(response, "headers", {}))
+                self._bucket.defer(delay)
+                retries += 1
+                if retries > 3:
+                    raise PollingError("Alpaca remained rate limited after retries")
+                continue
+            if status is not None and status >= 400:
+                raise PollingError(f"Alpaca request failed with HTTP {status}")
+            return response.json() if callable(getattr(response, "json", None)) else response
+
+    def _retry_after(self, headers: Mapping[str, Any]) -> float:
+        value = next((v for k, v in headers.items() if str(k).lower() == "retry-after"), None)
+        if value is None:

+        try:

+        except (TypeError, ValueError):

+            except (TypeError, ValueError, OverflowError):

+
+    def poll_cycle(self, symbols: Sequence[str]) -> tuple[PollSnapshot, ...]:

+        if not cleaned or any(not s for s in cleaned):

+            raise ValueError("symbol count exceeds max_symbols_per_cycle")

+        for kind in self.kinds:
+            data = self._get(self._ENDPOINTS[kind], {"symbols": ",".join(cleaned), "feed": self.feed})

+                snapshots.append(PollSnapshot(symbol, kind, source_ts, receive_ts,
+                                              feed_id, "rest_poll", stale, values))
+        return tuple(snapshots)
+
+    def recover_gap(self, symbol: str, timeframe: str, start: datetime,

+            symbol, timeframe, start_utc, end_utc, feed=self.feed, adjustment="raw")

+"""Offline contract tests for historical acquisition and bounded REST polling."""
+
+from dataclasses import fields
+from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
+from decimal import Decimal
+
+import pytest
+
+from mike_trade.market_data.alpaca_history import (
+    Adjustment,
+    AlpacaHistoricalBars,
+    BarProvenanceError,
+    HistoricalBar,
+    PaginationLimitError,
+    merge_bars,
+)
+from mike_trade.market_data.polling import PollKind, RestMarketDataPoller, TokenBucket
+
+
+T0 = datetime(2026, 1, 2, 15, 0, tzinfo=UTC)
+
+
+def bar(timestamp: str, **extra: object) -> dict[str, object]:
+    return {"t": timestamp, "o": 10.1, "h": 11.2, "l": 9.9, "c": 10.5,
+            "v": 100, "vw": 10.4, "n": 12, **extra}
+
+
+class Pages:
+    def __init__(self, pages: list[dict[str, object]]) -> None:
+        self.pages = pages
+        self.calls: list[tuple[str, dict[str, object] | None]] = []
+
+    def get(self, path: str, params: dict[str, object] | None = None) -> dict[str, object]:
+        self.calls.append((path, params))
+        return self.pages[len(self.calls) - 1]
+
+
+def test_history_paginates_orders_bars_and_preserves_decimal_types() -> None:
+    client = Pages([
+        {"bars": [bar("2026-01-02T15:01:00Z")], "next_page_token": "p2"},
+        {"bars": [bar("2026-01-02T15:00:00Z")], "next_page_token": None},
+    ])
+    bars = AlpacaHistoricalBars(client).fetch_bars(
+        "aapl", "1Min", T0, T0 + timedelta(minutes=3), adjustment="split")
+    assert len(client.calls) == 2
+    assert client.calls[1][1]["page_token"] == "p2"  # type: ignore[index]
+    assert [item.timestamp for item in bars] == sorted(item.timestamp for item in bars)
+    assert bars[0].timestamp.tzinfo is UTC
+    assert bars[0].feed_id == "iex" and bars[0].adjustment is Adjustment.SPLIT
+    for item in bars:
+        assert all(isinstance(getattr(item, field), Decimal)
+                   for field in ("open", "high", "low", "close", "vwap"))
+        assert isinstance(item.volume, (int, Decimal))
+        assert not any(isinstance(getattr(item, field.name), float) for field in fields(item))
+
+
+def test_history_honors_page_bound() -> None:
+    client = Pages([{"bars": [], "next_page_token": "again"}] * 3)
+    with pytest.raises(PaginationLimitError):
+        AlpacaHistoricalBars(client, max_pages=2).fetch_bars(
+            "AAPL", "1Min", T0, T0 + timedelta(minutes=1))
+    assert len(client.calls) == 2
+
+
+def test_mixed_feed_or_adjustment_provenance_is_rejected() -> None:
+    first = HistoricalBar("AAPL", T0, Decimal("1"), Decimal("2"), Decimal("1"),
+                          Decimal("2"), 1, Decimal("1.5"), 1, "iex", Adjustment.RAW)
+    second = HistoricalBar("AAPL", T0, Decimal("1"), Decimal("2"), Decimal("1"),
+                           Decimal("2"), 1, Decimal("1.5"), 1, "sip", Adjustment.RAW)
+    with pytest.raises(BarProvenanceError):
+        merge_bars([first], [second])
+    client = Pages([{"feed": "sip", "bars": []}])
+    with pytest.raises(BarProvenanceError):
+        AlpacaHistoricalBars(client).fetch_bars("AAPL", "1Min", T0, T0 + timedelta(minutes=1))
+
+
+class FakeClock:
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self.value = T0
+
+    def now(self) -> datetime:
+        return self.value
+
+    def sleep(self, seconds: float) -> None:
+        self.value += timedelta(seconds=seconds)
+
+
+class PollTransport:
+    def __init__(self, clock: FakeClock, *, rate_limit: bool = False) -> None:
+        self.clock = clock
+        self.calls: list[tuple[str, dict[str, object] | None]] = []
+        self.rate_limit = rate_limit
+        self.fixed_ts: datetime | None = None
+
+    def get(self, path: str, params: dict[str, object] | None = None) -> object:
+        self.calls.append((path, params))
+        if self.rate_limit and len(self.calls) == 1:
+            return Response(429, {"Retry-After": "3"})
+        key = "trades"
+        if "/quotes/" in path:
+            key = "quotes"
+        elif "/bars/" in path:
+            key = "bars"
+        timestamp = (self.fixed_ts or self.clock.now()).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
+        payload = {"t": timestamp, "feed_id": "iex", "p": "10.25", "s": 2}
+        return {key: {"AAPL": payload, "MSFT": payload}}
+
+
+class Response:
+    def __init__(self, status_code: int, headers: dict[str, str]) -> None:
+        self.status_code = status_code
+        self.headers = headers
+
+
+def test_poll_cycle_batches_symbols_instead_of_polling_per_consumer() -> None:
+    clock = FakeClock()
+    client = PollTransport(clock)
+    poller = RestMarketDataPoller(client, clock=clock, sleep=clock.sleep, kinds=(PollKind.TRADE,))
+    snapshots = poller.poll_cycle(["AAPL", "MSFT"])
+    assert len(client.calls) == 1
+    assert client.calls[0][1]["symbols"] == "AAPL,MSFT"  # type: ignore[index]
+    assert len(snapshots) == 2
+    assert all(s.source == "rest_poll" and s.feed_id == "iex" for s in snapshots)
+
+
+def test_token_bucket_defers_and_retry_after_delays_next_request() -> None:
+    clock = FakeClock()
+    delays: list[float] = []
+
+    def sleep(seconds: float) -> None:
+        delays.append(seconds)
+        clock.sleep(seconds)
+
+    limited = PollTransport(clock, rate_limit=True)
+    poller = RestMarketDataPoller(limited, clock=clock, sleep=sleep, requests_per_second=1,
+                                  burst=1, kinds=(PollKind.TRADE,))
+    poller.poll_cycle(["AAPL"])
+    assert any(delay >= 3 for delay in delays)
+    bucket = TokenBucket(capacity=1, refill_per_second=1, clock=clock.now, sleep=sleep)
+    before = clock.now()
+    bucket.acquire()
+    bucket.acquire()
+    assert (clock.now() - before).total_seconds() >= 1
+
+
+def test_unchanged_or_old_provider_timestamp_is_stale() -> None:
+    clock = FakeClock()
+    client = PollTransport(clock)
+    poller = RestMarketDataPoller(client, clock=clock, sleep=clock.sleep,
+                                  kinds=(PollKind.TRADE,), stale_after_seconds=2)
+    first = poller.poll_cycle(["AAPL"])[0]
+    second = poller.poll_cycle(["AAPL"])[0]
+    assert not first.stale
+    assert second.stale
+    clock.value += timedelta(seconds=3)
+    client.fixed_ts = T0
+    old = poller.poll_cycle(["AAPL"])[0]
+    assert old.stale
+
+
+def test_gap_recovery_is_bounded_and_uses_only_requested_window() -> None:
+    clock = FakeClock()
+    client = Pages([{"bars": [bar("2026-01-02T15:01:00Z")]}])
+    poller = RestMarketDataPoller(client, clock=clock, sleep=clock.sleep,
+                                  kinds=(PollKind.BAR,), max_gap=timedelta(minutes=5))
+    recovered = poller.recover_gap("AAPL", "1Min", T0, T0 + timedelta(minutes=2))
+    assert len(recovered) == 1
+    params = client.calls[0][1]
+    assert params["start"] == "2026-01-02T15:00:00Z"  # type: ignore[index]
+    assert params["end"] == "2026-01-02T15:02:00Z"  # type: ignore[index]
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="maximum"):
+        poller.recover_gap("AAPL", "1Min", T0, T0 + timedelta(minutes=6))

+"""Bounded, provenance-aware Alpaca historical stock bar acquisition."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Mapping
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
+from enum import StrEnum
+from typing import Any
+
+__all__ = ["Adjustment", "HistoricalBar", "AlpacaHistoryError", "BarProvenanceError",
+           "PaginationLimitError", "AlpacaHistoricalBars", "merge_bars"]
+
+
+class Adjustment(StrEnum):
+    RAW = "raw"
+    SPLIT = "split"
+    DIVIDEND = "dividend"
+    ALL = "all"
+
+
+class AlpacaHistoryError(ValueError):
+    """Invalid or incomplete Alpaca historical data response."""
+
+
+class BarProvenanceError(AlpacaHistoryError):
+    """Bars in a request or merge do not share feed and adjustment provenance."""
+
+
+class PaginationLimitError(AlpacaHistoryError):
+    """The response still has another page after the configured page limit."""
+
+
+def _utc(value: datetime, field: str) -> datetime:
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a timezone-aware datetime")
+    return value.astimezone(UTC)
+
+
+def _decimal(value: Any, field: str) -> Decimal:
+    if isinstance(value, bool):
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be numeric")
+    try:
+        result = value if isinstance(value, Decimal) else Decimal(str(value))
+    except (InvalidOperation, ValueError, TypeError):
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be numeric") from None
+    if not result.is_finite():
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be finite")
+    return result
+
+
+def _count(value: Any, field: str) -> int | Decimal:
+    if isinstance(value, bool):
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be integer or Decimal")
+    if isinstance(value, float):
+        return _decimal(value, field)
+    if isinstance(value, int):
+        return value
+    return _decimal(value, field)
+
+
+def _timestamp(value: Any) -> datetime:
+    if not isinstance(value, str):
+        raise ValueError("bar timestamp must be an ISO timestamp string")
+    text = value[:-1] + "+00:00" if value.endswith("Z") else value
+    try:
+        return _utc(datetime.fromisoformat(text), "bar timestamp")
+    except ValueError as exc:
+        raise ValueError("bar timestamp must be ISO formatted and timezone-aware") from exc
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class HistoricalBar:
+    symbol: str
+    timestamp: datetime
+    open: Decimal
+    high: Decimal
+    low: Decimal
+    close: Decimal
+    volume: int | Decimal
+    vwap: Decimal | None
+    trade_count: int | Decimal | None
+    feed_id: str
+    adjustment: Adjustment
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        symbol = self.symbol.strip().upper() if isinstance(self.symbol, str) else ""
+        if not symbol:
+            raise ValueError("symbol must be non-empty")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol", symbol)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "timestamp", _utc(self.timestamp, "timestamp"))
+        for field in ("open", "high", "low", "close"):
+            object.__setattr__(self, field, _decimal(getattr(self, field), field))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "volume", _count(self.volume, "volume"))
+        if self.vwap is not None:
+            object.__setattr__(self, "vwap", _decimal(self.vwap, "vwap"))
+        if self.trade_count is not None:
+            object.__setattr__(self, "trade_count", _count(self.trade_count, "trade_count"))
+        if not isinstance(self.feed_id, str) or not self.feed_id.strip():
+            raise ValueError("feed_id must be non-empty")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "feed_id", self.feed_id.strip().lower())
+        if not isinstance(self.adjustment, Adjustment):
+            object.__setattr__(self, "adjustment", Adjustment(self.adjustment))
+
+    @property
+    def adjustment_provenance(self) -> Adjustment:
+        """Explicitly named alias for the requested adjustment mode."""
+        return self.adjustment
+
+
+def merge_bars(*groups: tuple[HistoricalBar, ...] | list[HistoricalBar]) -> tuple[HistoricalBar, ...]:
+    """Merge bars only when every input shares the exact feed and adjustment."""
+    bars = [bar for group in groups for bar in group]
+    if not bars:
+        return ()
+    provenance = {(bar.feed_id, bar.adjustment) for bar in bars}
+    if len(provenance) != 1:
+        raise BarProvenanceError("cannot merge bars from different feeds or adjustments")
+    return tuple(sorted(bars, key=lambda bar: (bar.timestamp, bar.symbol)))
+
+
+class AlpacaHistoricalBars:
+    """Fetch historical bars using an injected object exposing ``get(path, params)``."""
+
+    def __init__(self, client: Any, *, max_pages: int = 20) -> None:
+        if not callable(getattr(client, "get", None)):
+            raise TypeError("client must expose get(path, params)")
+        if isinstance(max_pages, bool) or not isinstance(max_pages, int) or max_pages < 1:
+            raise ValueError("max_pages must be a positive integer")
+        self._client = client
+        self.max_pages = max_pages
+
+    def fetch_bars(
+        self, symbol: str, timeframe: Any, start: datetime, end: datetime, *,
+        feed: str = "iex", adjustment: Adjustment | str = Adjustment.RAW,
+    ) -> tuple[HistoricalBar, ...]:
+        symbol = symbol.strip().upper()
+        feed = feed.strip().lower()
+        try:
+            adjustment = Adjustment(adjustment)
+        except ValueError:
+            raise ValueError("adjustment must be raw, split, dividend, or all") from None
+        start_utc, end_utc = _utc(start, "start"), _utc(end, "end")
+        if start_utc >= end_utc:
+            raise ValueError("start must be before end")
+        timeframe_value = getattr(timeframe, "value", timeframe)
+        if not symbol or not feed or not isinstance(timeframe_value, str) or not timeframe_value.strip():
+            raise ValueError("symbol, timeframe, and feed must be non-empty")
+        timeframe_value = {
+            "1m": "1Min", "5m": "5Min", "15m": "15Min", "1h": "1Hour", "1d": "1Day",
+        }.get(timeframe_value.strip().lower(), timeframe_value.strip())
+        params: dict[str, Any] = {
+            "symbols": symbol, "timeframe": timeframe_value,
+            "start": start_utc.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z"),
+            "end": end_utc.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z"),
+            "feed": feed, "adjustment": adjustment.value,
+        }
+        token: str | None = None
+        bars: list[HistoricalBar] = []
+        for page in range(self.max_pages):
+            if token is not None:
+                params["page_token"] = token
+            data = self._client.get("/v2/stocks/bars", params=params.copy())
+            if not isinstance(data, Mapping):
+                raise AlpacaHistoryError("historical bars response must be an object")
+            response_feed = data.get("feed")
+            response_adjustment = data.get("adjustment")
+            if response_feed is not None and str(response_feed).lower() != feed:
+                raise BarProvenanceError("response feed differs from requested feed")
+            if response_adjustment is not None and str(response_adjustment).lower() != adjustment.value:
+                raise BarProvenanceError("response adjustment differs from requested adjustment")
+            result = data.get("bars")
+            if isinstance(result, Mapping):
+                result = result.get(symbol)
+            if not isinstance(result, list):
+                raise AlpacaHistoryError("historical bars response must contain a bars array")
+            for item in result:
+                if not isinstance(item, Mapping):
+                    raise AlpacaHistoryError("bar item must be an object")
+                item_feed = item.get("feed_id", item.get("feed", feed))
+                item_adjustment = item.get("adjustment", adjustment.value)
+                if str(item_feed).lower() != feed or str(item_adjustment).lower() != adjustment.value:
+                    raise BarProvenanceError("bar provenance differs from request")
+                bars.append(HistoricalBar(
+                    symbol=symbol, timestamp=_timestamp(item.get("t")),
+                    open=_decimal(item.get("o"), "open"), high=_decimal(item.get("h"), "high"),
+                    low=_decimal(item.get("l"), "low"), close=_decimal(item.get("c"), "close"),
+                    volume=_count(item.get("v"), "volume"),
+                    vwap=None if item.get("vw") is None else _decimal(item["vw"], "vwap"),
+                    trade_count=None if item.get("n") is None else _count(item["n"], "trade_count"),
+                    feed_id=feed, adjustment=adjustment,
+                ))
+            token = data.get("next_page_token")
+            if not token:
+                break
+        else:
+            raise PaginationLimitError(f"historical response exceeds max_pages={self.max_pages}")
+        return tuple(sorted(bars, key=lambda bar: bar.timestamp))

+"""Bounded REST polling fallback for the shared market-data service."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import email.utils
+import time
+from collections.abc import Mapping, Sequence
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
+from decimal import Decimal
+from types import MappingProxyType
+from typing import Any, Callable
+
+from mike_trade.market_data.alpaca_history import AlpacaHistoricalBars, HistoricalBar
+
+__all__ = ["PollKind", "PollSnapshot", "TokenBucket", "PollingError", "RestMarketDataPoller"]
+
+
+class PollKind:
+    TRADE = "trade"
+    QUOTE = "quote"
+    BAR = "bar"
+
+
+def _utc(value: datetime, name: str) -> datetime:
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a timezone-aware datetime")
+    return value.astimezone(UTC)
+
+
+def _parse_ts(value: Any) -> datetime:
+    if isinstance(value, datetime):
+        return _utc(value, "provider timestamp")
+    if not isinstance(value, str):
+        raise ValueError("provider timestamp must be ISO formatted")
+    text = value[:-1] + "+00:00" if value.endswith("Z") else value
+    return _utc(datetime.fromisoformat(text), "provider timestamp")
+
+
+def _dec(value: Any) -> Decimal | int | None:
+    if value is None:
+        return None
+    if isinstance(value, (int, Decimal)) and not isinstance(value, bool):
+        return value
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        return Decimal(value)
+    raise ValueError("snapshot numeric values must be int, Decimal, or string")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class PollSnapshot:
+    symbol: str
+    kind: str
+    provider_source_ts: datetime
+    receive_ts: datetime
+    feed_id: str
+    source: str
+    stale: bool
+    values: Mapping[str, Any]
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol", self.symbol.strip().upper())
+        object.__setattr__(self, "provider_source_ts", _utc(self.provider_source_ts, "provider_source_ts"))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "receive_ts", _utc(self.receive_ts, "receive_ts"))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "values", MappingProxyType(dict(self.values)))
+
+
+class PollingError(RuntimeError):
+    pass
+
+
+class TokenBucket:
+    """Synchronous token bucket driven by an injected datetime clock and sleeper."""
+
+    def __init__(self, *, capacity: float, refill_per_second: float,
+                 clock: Callable[[], datetime], sleep: Callable[[float], None] = time.sleep) -> None:
+        if capacity < 1 or refill_per_second <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("capacity and refill_per_second must be positive")
+        self.capacity = float(capacity)
+        self.refill_per_second = float(refill_per_second)
+        self._clock = clock
+        self._sleep = sleep
+        self._tokens = float(capacity)
+        self._updated = _utc(clock(), "clock")
+        self._blocked_until = self._updated
+
+    def defer(self, seconds: float) -> None:
+        if seconds > 0:
+            self._blocked_until = max(self._blocked_until, _utc(self._clock(), "clock") + timedelta(seconds=seconds))
+
+    def acquire(self) -> None:
+        while True:
+            now = _utc(self._clock(), "clock")
+            if now < self._blocked_until:
+                self._sleep((self._blocked_until - now).total_seconds())
+                continue
+            elapsed = max(0.0, (now - self._updated).total_seconds())
+            self._tokens = min(self.capacity, self._tokens + elapsed * self.refill_per_second)
+            self._updated = now
+            if self._tokens >= 1:
+                self._tokens -= 1
+                return
+            self._sleep((1 - self._tokens) / self.refill_per_second)
+
+
+class _LimitedClient:
+    def __init__(self, poller: "RestMarketDataPoller") -> None:
+        self._poller = poller
+
+    def get(self, path: str, params: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None) -> Any:
+        return self._poller._get(path, params)
+
+
+class RestMarketDataPoller:
+    """Fetch each watched symbol once per market-data kind in one batched call."""
+
+    _ENDPOINTS = {
+        PollKind.TRADE: "/v2/stocks/trades/latest",
+        PollKind.QUOTE: "/v2/stocks/quotes/latest",
+        PollKind.BAR: "/v2/stocks/bars/latest",
+    }
+
+    def __init__(self, client: Any, *, clock: Any, feed: str = "iex",
+                 requests_per_second: float = 5.0, burst: int = 5,
+                 poll_interval_seconds: float = 1.0, max_poll_interval_seconds: float = 60.0,
+                 max_symbols_per_cycle: int = 100, stale_after_seconds: float = 30.0,
+                 max_gap: timedelta = timedelta(hours=1), sleep: Callable[[float], None] = time.sleep,
+                 kinds: Sequence[str] = (PollKind.TRADE, PollKind.QUOTE, PollKind.BAR)) -> None:
+        if not callable(getattr(client, "get", None)):
+            raise TypeError("client must expose get(path, params)")
+        if not callable(getattr(clock, "now", None)):
+            raise TypeError("clock must expose now()")
+        if poll_interval_seconds <= 0 or max_poll_interval_seconds <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("poll intervals must be positive")
+        if max_symbols_per_cycle < 1 or stale_after_seconds < 0 or max_gap <= timedelta(0):
+            raise ValueError("poll bounds must be positive")
+        if any(kind not in self._ENDPOINTS for kind in kinds) or not kinds:
+            raise ValueError("kinds must contain trade, quote, and/or bar")
+        self._client, self._clock, self.feed = client, clock, feed.strip().lower()
+        self.poll_interval_seconds = min(poll_interval_seconds, max_poll_interval_seconds)
+        self.max_poll_interval_seconds = max_poll_interval_seconds
+        self.max_symbols_per_cycle = max_symbols_per_cycle
+        self.stale_after_seconds = stale_after_seconds
+        self.max_gap = max_gap
+        self.kinds = tuple(dict.fromkeys(kinds))
+        self._bucket = TokenBucket(capacity=burst, refill_per_second=requests_per_second,
+                                   clock=clock.now, sleep=sleep)
+        self._last_ts: dict[tuple[str, str], datetime] = {}
+        self._retry_until: datetime | None = None
+        self._sleep = sleep
+
+    def _get(self, path: str, params: Mapping[str, Any] | None) -> Any:
+        retries = 0
+        while True:
+            self._bucket.acquire()
+            try:
+                response = self._client.get(path, params=dict(params) if params else None)
+            except Exception as exc:
+                status = getattr(exc, "status_code", None) or getattr(getattr(exc, "response", None), "status_code", None)
+                if status != 429:
+                    raise
+                headers = getattr(exc, "headers", None) or getattr(getattr(exc, "response", None), "headers", {})
+                delay = self._retry_after(headers)
+                self._bucket.defer(delay)
+                retries += 1
+                if retries > 3:
+                    raise PollingError("Alpaca remained rate limited after retries") from exc
+                continue
+            status = getattr(response, "status_code", None)
+            if status == 429:
+                delay = self._retry_after(getattr(response, "headers", {}))
+                self._bucket.defer(delay)
+                retries += 1
+                if retries > 3:
+                    raise PollingError("Alpaca remained rate limited after retries")
+                continue
+            if status is not None and status >= 400:
+                raise PollingError(f"Alpaca request failed with HTTP {status}")
+            return response.json() if callable(getattr(response, "json", None)) else response
+
+    def _retry_after(self, headers: Mapping[str, Any]) -> float:
+        value = next((v for k, v in headers.items() if str(k).lower() == "retry-after"), None)
+        if value is None:
+            return 1.0
+        try:
+            return max(0.0, float(value))
+        except (TypeError, ValueError):
+            try:
+                return max(0.0, (email.utils.parsedate_to_datetime(str(value)).astimezone(UTC)
+                                 - _utc(self._clock.now(), "clock")).total_seconds())
+            except (TypeError, ValueError, OverflowError):
+                return 1.0
+
+    def poll_cycle(self, symbols: Sequence[str]) -> tuple[PollSnapshot, ...]:
+        cleaned = tuple(dict.fromkeys(s.strip().upper() for s in symbols))
+        if not cleaned or any(not s for s in cleaned):
+            raise ValueError("symbols must be non-empty")
+        if len(cleaned) > self.max_symbols_per_cycle:
+            raise ValueError("symbol count exceeds max_symbols_per_cycle")
+        snapshots: list[PollSnapshot] = []
+        for kind in self.kinds:
+            data = self._get(self._ENDPOINTS[kind], {"symbols": ",".join(cleaned), "feed": self.feed})
+            if not isinstance(data, Mapping):
+                raise PollingError("latest snapshot response must be an object")
+            field = {PollKind.TRADE: "trades", PollKind.QUOTE: "quotes", PollKind.BAR: "bars"}[kind]
+            records = data.get(field, {})
+            if not isinstance(records, Mapping):
+                raise PollingError(f"response {field} must be an object keyed by symbol")
+            receive_ts = _utc(self._clock.now(), "clock")
+            for symbol in cleaned:
+                item = records.get(symbol)
+                if item is None:
+                    continue
+                if not isinstance(item, Mapping):
+                    raise PollingError("snapshot item must be an object")
+                source_ts = _parse_ts(item.get("t"))
+                feed_id = str(item.get("feed_id", item.get("feed", self.feed))).lower()
+                if feed_id != self.feed:
+                    raise PollingError("snapshot feed differs from configured feed")
+                key = (symbol, kind)
+                stale = source_ts <= self._last_ts.get(key, source_ts - timedelta(microseconds=1))
+                stale = stale or (receive_ts - source_ts).total_seconds() > self.stale_after_seconds
+                self._last_ts[key] = source_ts
+                values = {k: (_dec(v) if k in {"p", "s", "bp", "bs", "ap", "as", "o", "h", "l", "c", "v", "vw"} else v)
+                          for k, v in item.items() if k not in {"t", "feed", "feed_id"}}
+                snapshots.append(PollSnapshot(symbol, kind, source_ts, receive_ts,
+                                              feed_id, "rest_poll", stale, values))
+        return tuple(snapshots)
+
+    def recover_gap(self, symbol: str, timeframe: str, start: datetime,
+                    end: datetime) -> tuple[HistoricalBar, ...]:
+        start_utc, end_utc = _utc(start, "start"), _utc(end, "end")
+        if end_utc <= start_utc:
+            raise ValueError("gap end must be after start")
+        if end_utc - start_utc > self.max_gap:
+            raise ValueError("gap window exceeds configured maximum")
+        return AlpacaHistoricalBars(_LimitedClient(self), max_pages=20).fetch_bars(
+            symbol, timeframe, start_utc, end_utc, feed=self.feed, adjustment="raw")
